checks.name: review 10: a size in a file name (icon-24px.png, icon-2x.png) is not a control's name
review 10: a file name with a size part (trash-24px.png) names nothing, not 'Trash 24px'
a density in an icon's file name (ic_delete_48dp.png) names nothing
a version in the query string does not stop a file name naming its icon (print.svg?v=3 is 'Print')
review 10: a standalone small image named only by a size (icon-24px.png) is left as it was
review 10: a file name that only says what kind of file it is (image.png, photo-placeholder.png) is not alt text
a kind word beside a real one stays in the name (acme-logo.png is 'Acme logo')
a link whose last path part has a number (top-10-tips) is not named without it ('Top tips')
a percent-encoded path (caf%C3%A9-specials) is not read as a name
a plain path still names its link (returns-policy is 'Returns policy')
review 10: an svg role=img with its own <title> is named, left alone and not described by the AI
an svg role=img whose only <title> is a part's is unnamed, and described as an informative image
